description: Regex search of the CURRENT source only (HEAD of the default branch), like `git grep -E`: ^ and $ anchor lines, . does not cross them; PostgreSQL syntax (\s, \w, (?i)). Returns files with repo_name, file_path, line_no and snippet (first match). Any other commit, every match with context, or history: code_search match=regex. Cite path:line with the sha.

path_glob.description: SQL LIKE on the path, e.g. "%/src/backend/%.c"

name: regex_search_code
